fixes.d: In August 2015 it emerged that in Hussain Khanwala village, Kasur district, a gang had filmed the sexual abuse of children and blackmailed their parents by threatening to leak the videos. Pakistani media put the number of children at 280 to 300; the joint investigation team set up by the Punjab government confirmed 19 genuine complaints, examined 47 video clips and charged 17 people (Express Tribune, 14 November 2015). Police, who had failed to act despite pleas from parents, made arrests only after clashes between relatives and authorities drew media attention. In 2016 an anti-terrorism court in Lahore sentenced two men to life imprisonment; Arab News reported in February 2018 that 12 other accused men were acquitted.
